content.short: Nuncius is a notification platform that alerts users via Email & Web Push on $ADA Transactions
content.description: With Nuncius, you can tailor your alerts for ADA transactions to fit your exact needs. We diligently monitor the Cardano blockchain, watching blocks as they happen, so you can stay in the know with near real-time updates on important blockchain events. Whether it’s tracking incoming or outgoing transactions, setting thresholds for ADA amounts, or keeping tabs on specific addresses, our system ensures you never miss a beat!
content.meta: Find out about Nuncius on the Cardano Blockchain, so you can make well-informed investment decisions. Get immediate access to the project Website, Social Media, Whitepaper and Token distribution.
